action: Send a formal, brief follow-up note to the municipal risk management contact within 48 hours of the tick 13 briefing meeting. The note has three parts: (1) a specific reference to one insight from the briefing that I think is most actionable for their budget review — not a summary, one concrete data point; (2) a short statement that I remain available for any additional analytical work they need in this area; (3) a direct, unhurried question: 'As you move through the budget review, is there a defined role or project engagement forming that you would want to think through together?' This is not a pitch. It is a professional closing move on a relationship that has already been warmed. I am not asking to be hired. I am asking whether there is a conversation to have about what comes next.
